note: Lightning Math (teen numbers minus ones, no borrow). English only. Teaching has no dangling question: the first scene says the teen number, the second says the take-away in words, the third states the answer. Type A (calc) = pure equation + three number keys. Type B (balloon) = one equation card + three balloons carrying answers. Type C (flash) = 5 s bar, same rules as L9 (timeout or wrong tap restarts on the same question).

lines.text: Look at the blocks. One ten and six ones. That's sixteen.
Now, let's look at the numbers. We take away the ones.
So, sixteen minus four equals twelve!
Remember, the ten stays the same.
We only take away from the ones.
Seventeen minus three. Tap the right answer.
Fourteen minus two. Tap the right answer.
Nineteen minus six. Tap the right answer.
Sixteen minus five. Tap the right answer.
Fifteen minus two. Which balloon has the answer?
Eighteen minus six. Which balloon has the answer?
Thirteen minus two. Which balloon has the answer?
Quick! Eighteen minus five equals what?
Quick! Nineteen minus seven equals what?
Quick! Fifteen minus four equals what?
